paragraphs.text: Deepseek Harness Plugin of Liquid Inference
# dsh-liquid-inference
Liquid Inference for DeepSeek Harness: a `liquid` model route plus read-only market tools.
## Install
Not published to npm yet. Install from GitHub or from a packed tarball, then export a buyer key with
the `spend` scope and restart the profile:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
**From GitHub.** The built `lib/` is committed, so no build step or `allowBuilds` entry is needed:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Pin a commit (`github:architect-xyz/liquid-dsh-plugin#<sha>`) so a later push cannot change what you
mit (`github:architect-xyz/liquid-dsh-plugin#<sha>`) so a later push cannot change what you install.
**From a tarball.** Needs no build permission:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Pick **Liquid Auto** (`liquid.auto`) in the model picker.
## What it adds
**Model route `liquid`** — no adapter code. The bundle patch configures the stock `llm-pi-ai` adapte
r with `api: openai-completions`, `baseURL: https://router.inference.ai.exchange/v1` and `apiKeyEnv:
ai-completions`, `baseURL: https://router.inference.ai.exchange/v1` and `apiKeyEnv: LIQUID_API_KEY`.
- **Cap.** Each request carries `x-liquid-cap-usd`, the most it can cost, locked before the first to

ken. The default is 1 USD; set `LIQUID_CAP_USD` in the launching environment to change it.
- **Model
s.** `liquid.auto` plus its ranking variants `:cheapest`, `:economy`, `:balanced` and `:premium` (do
cumented in the description of `GET /v1/exchange/routers`), and `deepseek-v4-flash` as a pinned mode

l. Add any id from `GET /v1/models` with a `models` entry in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`.
- **
Reasoning.** Levels `low`, `medium` and `high` are sent as `reasoning_effort`. The exchange passes t
he level through unchecked, so a level the winning provider rejects fails that request.
**Tools** (plugin `liquid-inference`)
| Tool | Endpoint | Key |

| `liquid_get_book` | `GET /v1/exchange/offers` | no |
| `liquid_get_markets` | `GET /v1/exchange/ma

rkets` | no |
| `liquid_get_routers` | `GET /v1/exchange/routers` | no |
| `liquid_get_job` | `GET /
v1/jobs/{id}` | yes |
Chat, image, speech and video purchases are deliberately not tools: the harness's own model route is
the one place that spends.
## Data flow
Full prompts and tool results go to `router.inference.ai.exchange`, which forwards them to whichever
third-party provider wins the auction. The key is read per request, from the credential store when
the profile mounts one and from `LIQUID_API_KEY` otherwise (headless profiles disable the store). It
is never written to config.
## Notes
- The patch replaces the `llm-pi-ai` row's whole `config`. If another bundle also configures pi-ai p

roviders, restate them in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`.
- Develop: `pnpm install && pnpm run ch
eck`. Commit the rebuilt `lib/` with source changes (CI fails on a stale one). `pnpm run test:instal
l` packs the bundle, installs the tarball into an isolated profile of a real dsh (`DSH_VERSION` pick
s the release, default `next`) and boots it; it needs network access.
